model_note: Projections are minutes x per-minute rates with fitted spreads. Ranges are honest (83-91% of outcomes landed inside the 10-90% band in testing), but the centre does not beat the betting market: on 2,607 closing props (20-26 Oct 2026) the model's Brier score was 0.259 vs the market's 0.248.
